title: Web Modern Frontend And Tauri Foundation
problem: Nako needs a release-oriented product frontend in web/ with a Tauri path. The existing apps/admin-web remains useful as validation/prototype support, while the v0 reference has strong UX direction but unacceptable Next.js, Vercel, TMDb, mock-data, and asset assumptions for shipping.
gates: npm --prefix web run check once web/ exists
npm --prefix web run test once web/ exists
npm --prefix web run build once web/ exists
Browser/Playwright smoke for visible frontend route changes
npm --prefix apps/admin-web run check && npm --prefix apps/admin-web run test && npm --prefix apps/admin-web run build until validation parity moves to web/

evidence.summary: Opened the replacement frontend lane after accepting that web/ is the product release line, apps/admin-web is validation/prototype support, and the v0 reference should be re-authored into a Vite React SPA with a Tauri path.

Created the web/ Vite React product frontend, route-first Media/Admin shell, Tailwind v4 and shadcn-style primitives, TanStack Router/Query package, Tauri v2 shell skeleton, Nako-owned Tauri icons, and initial Rust/server capability gap inventory.

Re-authored the route shell into Nako-owned visual tokens, active navigation, product-facing empty states, generated artwork placeholders, and desktop/mobile-smoked Media/Admin surfaces while preserving Tauri compile health.

Added web/src/api Media and Admin boundaries, wired @nako/sdk for Public Client access, generated a web-local Admin API contract, added fixture/live section results, and extended Rust generator drift tests to cover the new contract copy.

Connected Media Web routes to the web/src/api/media boundary with TanStack Query, fixture/live result status, Continue Watching, libraries, library source inventory, item source selection, and browser playback ticket handling.

Connected Admin routes to the web/src/api/admin boundary with TanStack Query, fixture/live result status, overview metrics, managed-library readiness, jobs, Addon registrations, and settings readiness without adding unsafe mutation controls.

Deepened the Tauri shell with no-secret server profile bootstrap commands, runtime health-check-backed server profile storage, desktop/browser setup UI state, and Windows Tauri build smoke while keeping native playback explicitly split.
Recorded the old apps/admin-web retirement plan, parity matrix, validation-only maintenance rules, deletion-over-archive target, and blocking gaps while keeping the old console in place.

continue_policy.notes: Continue with WMFT-090 closeout. Do not delete apps/admin-web before ADMIN_WEB_RETIREMENT_PLAN.md rows are ready, moved to CI, or split to accepted follow-ons. Do not ship the v0 Next.js app, TMDb API route, Vercel analytics, or bundled third-party media artwork.
